messages:
maya_sales: FYI - LedgerCorp wants a 30d POC. Requirements: strict EU-only data path, BYO-KMS, and tenant-level pinning. They asked for a no-US-subprocessors guarantee or at least attestations. Need feasibility, cost delta, and timeline.

oscar_se: Quick q: are they ok with Hosted + EU pinning or do they insist on Dedicated/Private for control-plane isolation?

maya_sales: Their legal team is pushing for both control + data in EU but sales thinks Hosted could be acceptable if we can show subprocessors attestation.

nate_ops: Short answer: doable with constraints. Options:
- Hosted w/ tenant pin to eu-west-1 + subprocessors whitelist. Control plane may still touch global infra for signaling unless we enable EU control-plane feature (extra ops).
- Dedicated/Private: full EU control plane, easier to certify no-US processing.

nate_ops: Timelines: Hosted EU-pin + KMS stub = ~1 week. BYO-KMS full attestation + key escrow tests = 1-2 weeks. Dedicated provisioning = 3-6 weeks depending on capacity.

nate_ops: Cost delta (ballpark): Hosted EU-pin: +15% unit uplift. Dedicated: upfront provisioning + higher monthly reserved fee. Will need QPS for exact numbers.

jana_product: I can assemble a 30d POC spec: eu-west-1 sandbox, BYO-KMS staging, runbook, telemetry opt-out. I'll include acceptance criteria and legal checklist.

secbot: Security checklist: DPA w/ subprocessors appendix, vendor attestation for EU-only processing, KMS attestation, SOC2, network egress diagram. If customer requires hard no-US subprocessors we must validate and capture vendor configs in writing.

maya_sales: Action items: 1) I'll ask LedgerCorp whether Hosted w/ EU-control-plane toggle is acceptable. 2) @nate_ops please produce subprocessors list (region+EU endpoint) and quick pricing deltas by EOD. 3) @jana_product draft POC SOW template and legal pre-reqs.

nate_ops: On it, will share a CSV with endpoints and assumptions in ~4 hours.

maya_sales: Thanks — I'll update LedgerCorp and report back.
